h1: Acrylic signs with a clear design purpose
lead: Acrylic offers several ways to present a business identity, from a simple wall panel to layered dimensional elements. A clear surface can reveal the wall behind the design, while colored or opaque pieces create a stronger block of contrast. For New York reception areas, doors and retail interiors, the right choice depends on the artwork and the surrounding light. Vision Graphics helps turn those visual choices into a considered sign brief, including edge appearance, graphic placement, mounting and the way the sign will be viewed.

sections.html: A panel can organize a logo, department name or donor message; separate acrylic letters can let the wall become the background. Layered elements may introduce depth. Decide whether edges and fixings should be visible features or quieter details, and check how reflections affect readability.

Provide vector artwork where available and a photo of the intended location. A proof should show proportions, text placement and the relationship between the panel and surrounding objects. Material grade, thickness, finish and fixings need to be specified for the particular application rather than assumed from a photograph.
